non_scope: Frontend / visual dashboard UI (backend schema and API contracts only)
Integration Hub and external API credentials (NXS-P07)
Messaging channels, OTP, telephony, ElevenLabs, agent runtime, workflows, campaigns (later phases)
CRM, billing, quotas, cell assignment, Sentinel, compliance, audit platform, metering (later phases)
Settings write API beyond provisioning-time defaults (no P05-owned mutating settings surface)
Dashboard configuration API (default baseline only; configuration surfaces belong to later phases)
Email delivery for owner invitations (owner user must already exist)
objective: Build the permanent enterprise Organization Provisioning foundation: a strongly validated onboarding contract, a durable idempotency ledger with canonical request fingerprints, a transactional OrganizationProvisioner that creates the Organization core record, the owner membership and org_owner assignment, P05-owned organization settings and the baseline dashboard configuration in explicit phases with crash-safe resume semantics, a platform-level organization:create capability, P04 transactional outbox events (organizations.provisioned), and a versioned, deterministic, permission-filtered dashboard schema backed by an allow-listed widget/data-source registry — all under P02 forced RLS, P03 live-state auth/RBAC and the P04 event platform, proven by the P05 unit/integration/security/concurrency/resilience/contract matrices and a clean-room validation on linux/amd64 and linux/arm64.
title: Provisioner and Dashboard Schema
